notes: Leveling, farming spots, class quests and where items come from work without any other addon: when no quest database is in the game, the program downloads it once a week (Settings → Calculations can turn it off).
The WoWForDesk addon (0.6.1) notes which quests you have done and carry, so finished quests are left out without any other addon too.
A new version shows as a big gold card in the lower right corner: Restart now, What's new, Later.
